OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore/Hong Kong, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Finance Transformation & Strategy PMO to join our Intelligence & Performance (IP) team.

This role sits at the intersection of finance, data, and technology. You will drive Finance’s digital and AI transformation, connecting finance, business, product, data, and engineering teams, and turning operational and financial management needs into workable processes, data products, and system solutions. Your goal is to raise financial operating efficiency and data quality, give management reliable BI and actionable insight, and help build the financial systems and internal controls the company needs as it scales.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to build, not just coordinate. You should be comfortable with ambiguity, complexity, and senior stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Finance transformation programs end to end. Build the roadmap for finance digitalization and AI transformation, prioritize projects, and define scope, milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria. Run cross-functional delivery from requirements through launch, training, and continuous improvement.
  • Own financial BI and decision support. Build a unified financial and operational metrics framework with consistent definitions and dashboards covering revenue, cost, profit, budget execution, cash flow, and operational efficiency.
  • Turn data into action. Explain business changes and anomalies to management, identify opportunities in cost, efficiency, and resource allocation, and work with business teams to execute and track the results.
  • Design finance solutions and automate processes. Map finance processes, business rules, and system requirements into clear process designs, data models, and functional specs. Drive automation across bookkeeping, reconciliation, settlement, reporting, budgeting, and management analysis, and coordinate integration across ERP, finance platforms, data platforms, and business systems.
  • Improve data quality and control. Strengthen reconciliation, exception handling, and data lineage so that definitions are consistent and key numbers are traceable.
  • Land AI and Agent applications in Finance. Identify high-value AI use cases across finance, business analysis, internal control, and audit support. Take them from prototype to production with product, data, and engineering teams, including intelligent analysis, anomaly detection, document processing, and knowledge retrieval. Define success metrics, human review, permissions, and audit trails.
  • Build compliance and internal control foundations. Work with Finance, Legal, Compliance, IT, and Audit on gap assessments and remediation plans. Drive SOX-related controls, ITAC, and ITGC, and embed key controls into finance processes, systems, and data flows (access, segregation of duties, change management, data integrity, audit trail).
  • Keep leadership informed. Give clear executive updates on progress, risks, and trade-offs, and act as a force multiplier by driving alignment and execution clarity across teams.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in finance products, finance digitalization, financial BI, or solutions roles, with a track record of turning finance requirements into system or data solutions and getting them adopted.
  • Solid understanding of finance operations: general ledger, AP/AR, revenue recognition, reconciliation, settlement, budgeting, and audit, with the ability to identify business rules and key control points.
  • Strong data analysis capability. Independently use SQL to query, validate, and analyze data, and know at least one mainstream BI tool. Able to define metrics, analyze performance, and turn findings into recommendations that management understands and teams can execute.
  • Experience designing solutions and building, integrating, or optimizing ERP, finance platforms, BI platforms, or automation systems, with the ability to work effectively with product and engineering.
  • Strong cross-functional project management: able to align multiple stakeholders, manage priorities and dependencies, and push through complex problems.
  • Understanding of internal control and auditability requirements for financial systems, and the ability to judge where AI fits in finance scenarios and help validate and roll it out.
  • Independent thinking and high ownership. You challenge assumptions constructively, form your own point of view, and operate with a strong bias toward action.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management, including with senior executives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with IPO preparation, SOX, ITAC, ITGC, or internal control build-out at a listed company.
  • Experience building management-oriented business analysis and financial BI systems, and explaining how analysis drives decisions.
  • Hands-on experience implementing LLMs, AI agents, enterprise knowledge bases, or finance intelligence applications.
  • Background in banking, payments, fintech, SaaS, e-commerce, or other high-volume businesses. Familiarity with trading, fund and asset flows, reconciliation, and finance operations in the digital asset industry is a plus.
  • Bilingual (English + Mandarin) to collaborate across global teams.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About The Opportunity

The Account team owns how every OKX user first gets in and keeps getting in safely. That covers registration, login and authentication, session and device management, account recovery, account security, sub-accounts and institutional accounts, and the full account lifecycle. We build the identity and access foundation that every other product depends on. That foundation has to scale to millions of users across regions and be resilient against constant attack, while still feeling easy to use. Our goal is a platform where strong security and a smooth user experience support each other rather than compete. For accounts, "mostly secure" isn't secure. Every control we build has to be consistent in how it's enforced, complete in what it covers, and explainable when it acts.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Formulate, select and develop technical designs across the account domain. That includes registration and onboarding, login and multi-factor authentication, passwordless login, third-party and single sign-on, session and device management, account recovery, sub-account and institutional account structures, and account lifecycle controls such as freezing, closure and data retention.
  • Build AI/ML-powered features such as account-takeover detection, suspicious-login detection, automated attack and bot defense, risk-based authentication, smarter recovery flows, and support-assist tools for account issues.
  • Organize and coordinate resources, lead research and development, troubleshoot problems, and ensure quality and on-time delivery. This includes integrating AI models into login, risk and recovery workflows.
  • Facilitate cross-team communication and promote efficient teamwork through code quality control and collaboration. This includes partnering with Security, Risk, Data Science, Compliance and Customer Support to bring models into production on reliable, auditable infrastructure.
  • Define where AI-driven judgment is appropriate and where fixed rules are mandatory. For example, a risk score can trigger an extra verification step, but the final access decision and its record have to stay rule-based. Design that boundary cleanly so models help without weakening security guarantees.
  • Take on team tasks and develop technical talent, with a focus on building AI engineering best practices across the team. That means AI-assisted development workflows, reusable prompt patterns, quality evaluation, and human review of AI-generated work in security-critical areas.

What We Look For In You

  • A security-first systems mindset. You naturally design for reliability, safe retries, consistent state, abuse prevention and complete audit trails. You know that in account security, missing an attack means a hijacked account and lost funds, while blocking a real user means lost trust, and you design with both in mind. Prior experience with identity, authentication, access management, anti-fraud or account security is a strong plus. Hands-on experience handling a real account-takeover incident or large-scale attack is an even stronger plus.
  • Solid knowledge of modern authentication and authorization standards, and their common pitfalls.
  • Daily, fluent use of modern AI coding tools. You can describe the specific workflows you run, the failure modes you've hit, and the guardrails you've built around AI-generated code, especially in security-sensitive code. AI fluency is required, not nice-to-have.
  • Production experience integrating AI/ML models into backend services. That includes model serving, real-time signal and data pipelines, low-latency inference on critical user paths, safe fallback when models fail, and processes for monitoring and rolling back models.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one LLM application pattern: knowledge retrieval for support and internal lookup, multi-step AI assistants for support or risk analysts, or LLM-based classification or extraction shipped to production.
  • Discipline around AI output. You don't ship AI features without proper evaluation, accuracy and abuse testing, regression checks, and human review for high-stakes actions such as account recovery or unfreezing. You have an opinion on when to use a large general-purpose model, a smaller specialized model or a simple rule, and you can defend that choice to Security and Audit.
  • A good grasp of software engineering basics and distributed systems principles, including consistency, reliability and data integrity, plus high availability and low latency for high-traffic, user-facing services.
  • Clear logic, quick thinking and good communication, including the ability to write clearly for non-engineers such as product, support, security and audit.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

Staff Engineer, Machine Learning & Data Infrastructure

We are looking for an experienced engineer to lead the architecture and hands-on development of the ML and data infrastructure behind our risk and fraud prevention systems. You will help teams move models from experimentation into reliable production services, improve model execution performance, and build scalable data foundations for training, evaluation, and real-time decisions.

Responsibilities

- Improve model inference latency, throughput, resource utilization, and cost. Profile the full prediction path—from feature retrieval and preprocessing to model execution—and deliver measurable improvements without unacceptable model-quality regressions.
- Build reusable infrastructure for model packaging, versioning, deployment, serving, monitoring, and rollback across cloud platforms and regions.
- Design and optimize offline data pipelines on Databricks, Apache Spark, and warehouse/lakehouse technologies, addressing data modeling, partitioning, joins, shuffles, skew, incremental processing, and cost.
- Connect offline and online feature pipelines, ensuring point-in-time correctness, consistent feature definitions, freshness, lineage, and reproducible backfills.
- Evolve reliable feature services and data integrations supporting risk models and decision systems.
- Set technical direction, mentor engineers, and lead delivery across ML, data engineering, cloud infrastructure, security, and product teams.

Required qualifications

- A record of building and operating large-scale distributed systems, ML infrastructure, or data platforms, with technical ownership across teams.
- Hands-on experience optimizing production model performance, supported by measurable improvements in latency, throughput, utilization, or cost.
- Deep understanding of Databricks and Spark, or comparable offline data platforms, including execution plans, distributed query optimization, storage layouts, data correctness, and workload cost management.
- Experience with the model lifecycle, including training/serving integration, validation, deployment, observability, and rollback.
- Strong Python, SQL, and at least one backend or systems language such as Java, Scala, Go, or C++.
- Ability to turn ambiguous requirements into clear architecture and deliver maintainable systems through hands-on engineering and technical leadership.

Helpful experience

- SageMaker, Alibaba Cloud PAI/EAS, or comparable ML platforms.
- Inference optimization using tools such as ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, or Triton.
- Delta Lake, MLflow, feature stores, Kafka, Flink, and low-latency data stores.
- Fraud detection or financial risk systems.

jobs.description_text: About the Team The Applied AI Engineering team is responsible for helping developers and enterprises safely and effectively deploy OpenAI technologies in production. We act as trusted technical advisors and thought partners for customers, working side by side with their teams to identify high-value use cases, design practical architectures, and move from prototype to durable deployment. Cybersecurity is one of the most urgent domains where AI can help. Security teams are under pressure to reason across code, logs, infrastructure, tickets, alerts, and vulnerability data faster than ever. As frontier models become more capable, organizations need deep technical guidance on how to evaluate, validate, and safely deploy AI systems in security-critical workflows. About the Role We are looking for an Applied AI Engineer, Cyber to partner with customers and help them apply OpenAI models, APIs, Codex, and agentic workflows to real cybersecurity use cases. You will work with CISOs, security executives, application security leaders, SOC teams, security engineering teams, and hands-on practitioners to identify where AI can create measurable security outcomes. This is a customer-facing technical role for someone who can move fluidly between executive strategy, practitioner-level cyber depth, and hands-on solution design. You will help customers evaluate and deploy workflows such as secure code review, vulnerability triage, threat modeling, remediation, SOC and incident response workflows, detection engineering, cloud security, GRC automation, and security validation. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Research, and Security to turn customer needs into safe deployment patterns, reusable field assets, and product feedback.
